errors.quote: Divided by $V=Tp$, the cost of each of seven kinds of operation is a power of $p$
errors.problem: The paper's Table of costs has nine rows. Seven of them give the dominant powers in eq:margin-list, and two (final scaling, and input/padding/carries/output) are absorbed. The normalized costs are bounded by those powers only up to constants, for example log(rp)=O(p^{1-eps}). They are not literally powers of p.
